expectations.text: Uses a diagram or structured layout in plain text (ASCII / indented list / table) of partitions and consumers, with something left for the learner to predict
expectations.evidence: Code-block diagram: [P0] [P1] [P2], C1–C4, "分配结果（请填 ?）：C1 读 → ? …"

expectations.text: Asks the learner to predict before showing the complete assignment (e.g. which consumer reads which partition, or what happens with more consumers than partitions)
expectations.evidence: "让你预测填空。完整的图等你答完再给"; scenario is 3 partitions / 4 consumers

expectations.text: Does not show the answer in the same message
expectations.evidence: Never states that one consumer sits idle; only says "你写出一种可能的分配就行，我看的是分配的规律"

expectations.text: Does not claim to render an interactive or clickable diagram
expectations.evidence: Plain code-block diagram; reply format is typed text
